public_rationale: All three parts are supported for Google's AI organization and its next flagship model [e1–e4]. July 23 reporting named senior departures including Noam Shazeer and John Jumper; Fortune's August 10 report described the August 5 announcement that Jeff Dean and several other prominent researchers were leaving [e1, e2]. The July 23 account summarized testimony from six current and former DeepMind employees describing low morale [e2]. Google announced on May 19 that Gemini 3.5 Pro would arrive in June, but said on July 22 that it was still in testing, establishing a missed release window [e3, e4]. Google reported lower AI staff attrition and disputed that morale was delaying models; those statements do not refute the named senior departures, reported dissatisfaction or missed June window [e1–e5].
limitations: The evidence supports a succession of senior AI departures, not unusually high attrition across Alphabet's entire workforce [e1, e2, e5].
The morale accounts are not a representative survey; e2 summarizes Axios interviews rather than providing independent interviews.
The release comparison concerns Gemini 3.5 Pro, not every Google model [e3, e4].

our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion makes Google's AI research organization the relevant workforce, especially its senior researchers. 'Hemorrhaging' means a substantial succession of important departures, without requiring a particular company-wide attrition rate.
'Poor morale' means substantial reported dissatisfaction within that organization, not dissatisfaction among every employee.
'Latest model' means the next flagship Gemini release, rather than every smaller model Google releases.
For these ongoing conditions, use the latest completed month before publication, July 2026, together with developments through August 6. This reporting window is an evaluator choice.
criteria.support_condition: Credible reporting establishes substantial senior AI departures and poor morale during the target period, and release records show that the next flagship Gemini model had missed an announced release window.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable evidence establishes that one or more components were false during the target period. Evidence supporting some components and contradicting others warrants mixed.
